name_es: Juan Andrés (converso de Xàtiva; en latín Joannes Andreas; en el título inglés de 1652, Johannes Andreas Maurus)
language: Spanish (writing); trained as a faqīh in Arabic-Islamic learning (Wikipedia)
role_place: Former Muslim scholar from Xàtiva, converted in 1487 and baptised at Valencia Cathedral; later priest; author of the Confusión (Valencia, 1515).
why_relevant: In my reading, the only author who gives Aisha's ages and explicitly criticises the marriage in print (16th century, via the 1652 English translation).
fame: Known mainly to specialists in Spanish anti-Morisco polemic; the Confusión was banned by the Inquisition yet reprinted and translated (Wikipedia). Cited by en.wikipedia's Aisha article as the 16th-century commentator.
community: Former Sunni Muslim; Roman Catholic convert
